description: PRESENT-80 encryption datapath, iterative (one round per clock, 31 rounds), key schedule included, encrypt only. 16 parallel 4-bit S-boxes as LUT logic, the pLayer as pure wiring, an 80-bit key register.
export_stage: post-synthesis (synthesized snapshot; no fitting was run)

variants/design_textbook.v.role: source (counterfactual: register before the key addition)

variants/present_nokeep.vo.role: export (counterfactual: design.v without the keep pragmas)

redistribution: The exported netlists are tool output generated from FPGAPA-authored RTL. The Altera copyright header that quartus_eda writes is kept verbatim. No vendor simulation models, device databases or encrypted libraries are redistributed here.
regenerate: copy design.v next to quartus/build.tcl in a scratch directory, then run the export_flow commands
variants/README.md documents the one-line difference behind each counterfactual export
